name: go-project-layout
description: > Scaffold new Go projects and services: directory structure, cmd/ and internal/ conventions, when to use a flat layout, module naming, and main package wiring. Use when: "new Go project", "scaffold a service", "create project structure", "start a Go module", "how do I organize a new service", "set up folder structure". Not for: reviewing an existing architecture (go-architecture-review), DI wiring (go-dependency-injection), CI setup (go-ci).
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 用于快速搭建 Go 项目和服务骨架，规范目录结构、模块命名及 main 包组织，适合新项目初始化。
